release_basis: USER-EVIDENCE-R0 / CUT-2R1 (supersedes the CUT-2R release; includes CUT-2R1 install-authority argv contract and intake enforcement). A proof pack can never vouch for its own verifier.
third_party_verification_order: 1. obtain this VERIFIER-RELEASE.json from the repository/release you trust
2. shasum -a 256 <pack>/verify.mjs and compare against verifier_sha256 here
3. also compare proof-manifest.json verifier_sha256 against verifier_sha256 here
4. only then run: node verify.mjs (it prints VERIFIER_SHA256 as a convenience, never as proof)
